CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

3. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Football.
   C. Damage equipment used for Football.
   D. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.

   D. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

9. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   C. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   C. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

13. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rounders.

14. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

15. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
